newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares regain 3,000 level on bond rise.
newsitem.headline: French shares regain 3,000 level on bond rise.

text.p: French shares regained the 3,000 level, which they had given up on Monday, on the back of a rise in the futures and bond markets. But worries remained on the mark/dollar exchange rate and ahead of the Federal Reserve's "Beige Book" due later on Wednesday at 1800 GMT, dealers said.
* CAC-40 index up 18.22, or 0.61 percent, at 3,002.32 at 1025 GMT
* CAC-40 Aug futures 3,009 vs 2,989 at Tuesdays close.
